lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiZn2(PO4)2 is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 28-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Zn each coordinated by four O neighbors, while P centers have three O neighbors; O centers show three- or fourfold geometric coordination to Li, Zn, and P. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Li- and Zn-centered four-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Li-centered polyhedra.
